meta.ber_convention: NDA/DA_full/SW all on full-block bits (1024) — same denominator, fair compare. DA_data = DA errors / data bits (768) = standard info-BER (main-experiment gross). gain_vs_da_net uses DA_full (overhead-discounted); gain_vs_da_gross uses DA_data for reference. NDA has no pilot so full==data for NDA.
meta.selfcheck_note: SW is a blind selector → per-seed SW BER must be >= per-seed per-block-oracle (=Σ_b min(ne_n_b,ne_d_b)/bits). Violations>0 means fix is still buggy. SW MAY beat frame-level min(NDA,DA) — that is the legitimate per-block selection gain, not a bug.
